column3: API 35+: every Media3 MediaCodecAudioRenderer creates a platform LoudnessCodecController per audio session, and Media3 closes it when the renderer is released (LoudnessCodecController.release, from MediaCodecAudioRenderer.onRelease, Media3 1.11.0). On the API 36 emulator the platform's dispatcher still holds the listener of each, and through it Media3's controller: 28 held with at most three players alive, about seven more per lifecycle cycle. Rooted in the platform's binder stub; nothing SuperPlayer holds.
